subtitle: Out Cebu · Philippine Airlines
overview: A five-day Kansai tour flying Philippine Airlines from Cebu. Shop at Dotonbori and Shinsaibashi, meet the deer at Nara Park, see Arashiyama Bamboo Grove and the Golden Pavilion in Kyoto, then Osaka Castle, Umeda Sky Building and Rinku Outlet. A free day allows an optional Universal Studios Japan visit. Four-star hotels throughout.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Cebu, Nov 25–29 2026 to Nov 25–29 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Dotonbori: Osaka's lively canal-side entertainment and food district, known for its neon signs.
placeDesc.Shinsaibashi: Osaka's main shopping arcade district, next to Dotonbori.
placeDesc.Nara Deer Park: A large park in Nara where friendly deer roam freely among the temples.
placeDesc.Arashiyama Bamboo Grove: A path of tall bamboo in Kyoto's Arashiyama district.
placeDesc.Golden Pavilion: Kinkaku-ji, Kyoto's Zen temple with a pavilion covered in gold leaf.
placeDesc.Osaka Castle: Osaka's historic castle and landmark, a photo stop.
placeDesc.Umeda Sky Building: A twin-tower skyscraper in Osaka with an open-air observatory, a photo stop.
placeDesc.Rinku Outlet: An outlet shopping mall by the sea near Kansai Airport, with free time to shop.
placeDesc.Universal Studios Japan: Optional tour of Osaka's theme park on the free day, with ticket and transfer included.
